summary: TC Energy Corporation and its wholly owned subsidiary TransCanada PipeLines Limited furnished a Form 6-K on October 6, 2026, covering the month of October 2026. The sole exhibit is Exhibit 99.1, a copy of the registrants' amended Code of Business Ethics Policy, signed by Vice-President, Law and Corporate Secretary Jane M. Brindle. The filing notes TransCanada PipeLines relies on TC Energy's continuous disclosure under an Alberta and Ontario Securities Commission exemption. No transaction, stake, price, board recommendation, advisor, or structural mechanics are stated; this is a routine governance/ethics policy update, not a special situation.
